content: May 13, 2024 Early Recognition Is Critical for Ebola Infection Control What to know Download this color, printable poster in PDF format on basic infection control steps to take when treating a patient who may have Ebola disease. Early recognition is critical. This poster is intended for all healthcare facilities.
